description: This file implements opportunistic batching logic for the Kubernetes scheduler framework, including classes and methods for caching, hinting, and batching scheduling results to optimize pod scheduling.

classes.name: OpportunisticBatch
classes.description: A class that caches filtering and scoring results to optimize scheduling of common pods by batching operations.

classes.name: batchState
classes.description: Stores the signature, sorted nodes, and creation time for a batch state.

classes.name: schedulingCycle
classes.description: Tracks the cycle count, chosen node, and success status of a scheduling cycle.

methods.name: signUsingFramework
methods.description: Signs a pod using the framework's SignPod method.

methods.name: GetNodeHint
methods.description: Provides a node hint for scheduling based on cached batch state and previous cycle results.

methods.name: StoreScheduleResults
methods.description: Stores the results of a scheduling attempt for future batching.

methods.name: logUnusableState
methods.description: Logs and records metrics when the batch state is no longer usable.

methods.name: batchStateCompatible
methods.description: Checks if the current batch state is compatible with a new pod and scheduling cycle.

methods.name: stateEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the batch state is empty or invalid.

methods.name: newOpportunisticBatch
methods.description: Creates a new OpportunisticBatch instance with a specified signature function.
